name: mcp-tooling
description: Parent hub for MCP tool bridges: routes to five workflow modes (mcp-chrome-devtools for browser inspection and debugging, mcp-click-up for ClickUp task management, mcp-obsidian for Obsidian vault, markdown-note, and Iconic data.json rulebook management via notesmd-cli, the official obsidian CLI, and the cyanheads MCP, mcp-aside-devtools for AI-browser automation via the Aside browser, and mcp-notion for Notion workspace operations via the official @notionhq/notion-mcp-server over Code Mode plus direct Notion API for the 5 gaps and the data-source knowledge layer) plus four design transports (mcp-figma bridging to Figma Desktop, mcp-refero searching real-app UI design references via the Refero MCP, mcp-mobbin researching app/screen/flow design patterns via the Mobbin MCP, and mcp-magicpath looking up MagicPath components and design systems through the vendor CLI over a UTCP cli manual, its provider shipping no MCP server) through mode-registry.json and hub-router.json. The advisor sees one hub identity; workflowMode selects the packet. mcp-code-mode is the shared MCP execution substrate all modes reach through the unchanged code_mode registration key — it is external infrastructure, not a hub member, and stays a flat standalone skill.
